docs.summary:
A global session for interaction with the Slang library.

An application may create and re-use a single global session across multiple sessions, in order to amortize startups costs (in current Slang this is mostly the cost of loading the Slang standard library).

The global session is currently *not* thread-safe and objects created from a single global session should only be used from a single thread at a time.
